But the deployment is still too blunt: the single late-strong Industrial breakout is valuable enough that cutting the whole pocket destroys far more present-tense EV than the weak-window repair earns back.

De-risking only that cohort should improve the weaker windows without sacrificing too much of the dominant late-strong tape.
